messages:
sam: FYI dashboard alert this morning: service-account quota telemetry mismatch across tenants. numbers look low compared to raw logs.

olga: saw it too. my hunch: our sampling key is based on the incoming token hash but edge proxies rewrite/rotate tokens, so the same logical SA becomes many key-hashes -> undercount.

vikram: do we have traces? is effective_identity propagated and trusted (x-effective-identity)?

olga: pasted a short trace snippet: 
``
edge-proxy: recv auth=sha256:abc123 -> forwarded as bearer proxy-tkn-xyz
auth: introspect -> service_account=sa-900 effective_id=sa-900 verified=true
``
but the sampler uses `auth.key_hash` so each forwarded token looks unique.

jess: switching sampler to effective_id would help but we only get that after auth lookup. concern: added latency and auth service load. also privacy: effective_id is sensitive? maybe fine internally.

maria: suggestion: dual-path sampling. keep fast key-hash sampler for performance, and add a low-frequency deterministic sample keyed on verified effective_id (only when auth says verified=true). this captures the long-tail identities for attribution without doubling auth QPS.

vikram: config prototype: 
``
auth.sampling.fast_rate: 0.01
auth.sampling.identity.enabled: true
auth.sampling.identity.rate: 0.001
auth.sampling.identity.key: verified_effective_id || api_key_id
``

sam: guard against forged headers: only accept identity samples when auth verification flag is true.
olga: yep i'll add that check.
jess: also ensure the sampled payload contains `billing_project` and `tenant` for joinability in downstream metrics. otherwise console numbers will mismatch. minimal fields only.
maria: UI work: show two bars in telemetry panel (fast-sampled vs identity-sampled) and a tooltip about sampling bias. also add a small explanatory note in quota dashboards.

vikram: action items: (1) olga run a 24h passive identity sample (no feature flag) to estimate effective coverage and false positives; (2) i'll gate the new sampler behind `auth.sampling.v2` FF and add rollout canary; (3) maria will add console mockups and copy for the tooltip.

sam: can we aim for a canary next week? need monitoring alerts for delta between sampled counts and raw logs.
olga: i'll drop the numbers by EOD today. if clean i'll open the auth PR.
maria: will post the UI mock by tomorrow morning.
authbot: Note: canary policy requires >=2h window and alert `telemetry.sampling.delta > 20%` for rollback.
sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
_meta: Slack thread about improving telemetry sampling and quota attribution for service-account tokens; root timestamp used as filename timestamp
